arabic text: ASHK AANKHON MEN HAI MAATAM HAI BAPAA EHLE AZAA
english translation text: EYES ARE TEARFUL, LAMENTATION HAS COME TO PASS, O MOURNERS

arabic text: MAJLIS-E GHAM MEN KAREN AAIYE MILKAR YE DUAA
english translation text: LET US PRAY IN THIS MAJLIS OF MORNING

arabic text: BHAAI ZINDAA RAHE BEHNON KE BAHAQQE ZEHRAA
english translation text: LONG MAY BROTHERS LIVE FOR THEIR SISTERS FOR THE SAKE OF ZAHRA S.A

arabic text: TAA QAYAAMAT RAHE MAAN BEHNON KAA QAAYAM PARDAA
english translation text: MAY THE MODESTY OF OUR WOMENFOLK REMAIN SAFEGUARDED FOREVER

arabic text: SHAANE USS BHAAI KE ALLAAH SALAAMAT RAKHKHE\nJO BANAA-E GAYE BEHNON KI HIFAAZAT KE LIYE
english translation text: MAY THE ARMS OF THOSE BROTHERS STAY STRONG\nWHO WERE CREATED TO PROTECT THEIR SISTERS

arabic text: SHABBIR DUAA KARTE THE ROKAR TAHE KHANJAR
english translation text: SHABBIR (A.S) CRIED IN SUPPLICATION UNDER THE DAGGER

arabic text: SAR MERAA KATE GHAM NAHIN LIT JAAYE BHARAA GAR
english translation text: MY HEAD BE SEVERED AND MY HOME RANSACKED, I DO NOT FEAR

arabic text: REH-JAAE MERI ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: IF ONLY MY BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL IS SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: SAB QATL HO ASBAAB BHI LUT JAAYE HAMAARAA
english translation text: WE ALL BE SLAUGHTERED, OUR BELONGINGS SNATCHED

arabic text: ASGHER KE LAGE TEER MUJHE YE BHI GAWAARAA
english translation text: EVEN AN ARROW STRIKES ASGHAR, I ACCEPT

arabic text: REH-JAAE MERI ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: IF ONLY MY BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL IS SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: ISS PARDE KI KHAATIR MERAA ABBAAS BHI MARJAAE
english translation text: FOR THIS VEIL MY ABBAS BE SACRIFICED

arabic text: AKBAR KE SINAA SINE PE LAGTI HAI TO LAGJAAE
english translation text: SHOULD A SPEAR PIERCE THE HEART OF AKBAR, SO BE IT

arabic text: REH-JAAE MERI ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: IF ONLY MY BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL IS SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: TUKDE HO MERE QAASIME NAASHAAD KAA LAASHAA
english translation text: TRAMPLED TO PIECES BE MY YOUTHFUL QASIM'S BODY

arabic text: JAL JAAE MERE ASGHARE MAASUM KAA JULAA
english translation text: BURNT TO ASHES BE THE CRADLE OF MY INNOCENT ASGHAR

arabic text: REH-JAAE MERI ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: IF ONLY MY BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL IS SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: MAASUM SAKINAA MUJHE ROTI HAI TO RO-E
english translation text: IF SAKINA IS MADE TO WEEP, LET IT BE SO

arabic text: WOH MERE BINAA SO NAHIN SAKTI HAI NA SO-E
english translation text: SHOULD SEE BE UNABLE TO SLEEP WITHOUT ME, LET IT BE SO

arabic text: REH-JAAE MERI ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: IF ONLY MY BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL IS SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: SUGHRAA MERI RORO KE GUZAR JAAE WATAN MEN
english translation text: IF MY SUGHRA CRIES TO HER DEATH BACK HOME

arabic text: ITNE HI LAGE TIRO TABAR MERE BADAN MEN
english translation text: AS MANY SWORDS AND ARROWS STRIKE MY BODY

arabic text: REH-JAAE MERI ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: IF ONLY MY BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL IS SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: PAR BAADE SHAHEDIN YE AJAB SAANEHAA GUZRAA
english translation text: YET, SOON AFTER HUSSAIN'S MARTYRDOM A TRAGEDY HAPPENED

arabic text: KHAIMON KI TARAF SHEH KE BAD-HAA LASHKARE AADAA
english translation text: TOWARD THE TENTS MARCHED THE ARMY OF OPPRESSORS

arabic text: BAAQI NA RAHAA ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: ALAS, THE BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL WAS NOT SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: AKBAR KO PUKAARAA KABHI SARWAR KO PUKAARAA
english translation text: SHE CRIED OUT TO AKBAR AND TO HUSSAIN

arabic text: KEHTI THI MADAD KIJI-E BAABAA MERE BAABAA
english translation text: HELP ME DEAR FATHER - SHE PLEADED

arabic text: BAAQI NA RAHAA ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: ALAS, THE BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL WAS NOT SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: ISS PARDE KI KHAATIR MERE BHAYYAA GAYE MAARE
english translation text: MY BROTHER WAS KILLED FOR THE SAKE OF THIS VEIL

arabic text: ABBAAS KE SHAANE BHI KATE NEHR KANAARE
english translation text: ABBAS LOST HIS ARMS BY THE BANKS OF THE RIVER

arabic text: BAAQI NA RAHAA ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: ALAS, THE BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL WAS NOT SPARED

arabic text: HAMSHIR KAA PARDAA MERI DILGIR KA PARDAA
english translation text: THE VEIL OF MY SISTER, THE VEIL OF THE HEARTBROKEN

arabic text: RAHAAN AJAB WAQT THAA AAFAT KI GADI THI
english translation text: REHAN (POET) STRANGE WAS THE HOUR, A TIME OF CALAMITY

arabic text: ISLAAM KI BE-GORO KAFAN LAASH PADI THI
english translation text: THE CORPSE OF ISLAM LAY BARE & UNBURIED

arabic text: KAAM AAGAYAA YUN ZAINABE DILGIR KAA PARDAA
english translation text: THE BROKEN HEARTED ZAINAB'S VEIL CAME THROUGH
